parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the trashcan is made of polypropylene plastic, typically curved and hinged to allow easy opening and closing. It covers the top of the trashcan to contain odors and conceal waste.
parts.Functional_description: The lid functions as a cover to prevent odors from escaping and to keep the trash out of sight. It may include a flap or swing mechanism for hands-free operation.
parts.Movement_description: The lid can rotate or swing open and closed, either manually or via a hinge mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the trashcan is a tall, rectangular container made of polypropylene plastic. It forms the main storage compartment for waste.
parts.Functional_description: The base body holds the trash bag and provides structural support for the lid. It is designed to be durable, lightweight, and easy to clean.
parts.Movement_description: The base body is stationary during normal use but can be lifted or moved when emptying or cleaning the trashcan.
